svg.title: One head, one decode step: scores → softmax → where it looks
svg.text: One head, one decode step: scores → softmax → where it looks
toy prompt of 11 tokens; real rows are thousands of tokens long

g.text: The prompt: 4 tools (2 tokens each), then the query "fly Paris". The model is about to write its answer.
Score per position = (query vector · key vector) / √d. One number per earlier token, for this one head.
Softmax, step 1: e^score makes every number positive and stretches the gaps (3.0 → 20.09, 0.0 → 1).
Softmax, step 2: divide each by the total Z = 48.62. The weights now sum to 1: where this head "looks".
argmax = position 3, "flight", inside tool B. That index is the only thing the copy rule and Hit Count read.
Note <s> (position 0) gets 0.186: the "attention sink". It is not a tool, so retrieval code must ignore it.
Every head of every layer has its own row like this at each decode step (32 × 32 = 1,024 rows in Llama-3.1-8B).
